The setting is a modern, brightly lit hallway with polished floors and metallic elevator doors. The younger woman smiles broadly at the camera while holding a large pink tote bag, while the older woman adjusts her mask and looks around curiously. (2) The scene cuts to the interior of a crowded exhibition hall where various promotional booths are visible. The two women walk arm-in-arm through the crowd, passing various bystanders. The lighting is typical of a large convention center, with overhead high-intensity lamps. Several posters with female models in revealing attire are visible in the background, along with booths draped in red cloth and metal trusses. (3) The women approach various models dressed in provocative costumes, such as a cow-print bikini and a bunny-eared maid outfit. The young woman points towards the models with a surprised expression, her mouth wide open in a laugh. The older woman looks on with a mix of amusement and curiosity, her hands occasionally gesturing toward the displays. Large text overlays in various colors appear intermittently at the bottom and middle of the frame. (4) The duo interacts with a male figure wearing an orange-taped patterned blazer and glasses in front of a bright yellow and pink backdrop labeled 'JVID'. They pose together, smiling and forming heart shapes with their hands. The background is filled with colorful graphics and large-scale promotional text. The young woman laughs heartily, leaning toward her mother, while the male actor maintains a cheerful, professional smile for the camera.
